decisive_source.finding: Applied and rolled-back plans bind only post_loadout_manifest_sha256 to the root active-loadout manifest. No post-operation component snapshot, target-generation activation, or component-identity readback is projected or checked before runtime or deployed proof.
The positive runtime fixture targets prompt-v2, leaves prompt-v2 inactive and prompt-v1 active, then expects the runtime projection to pass after changing only the active-loadout manifest digest.
The public schema closes the current fields but contains no operation-bound post-component readback artifact capable of expressing the missing semantic join.

new_counterexample.name: applied_swap_runtime_and_deployed_without_target_component_activation_or_component_readback
new_counterexample.precondition: The proposal, capsule, external decision, and swap plan are complete constructor-produced artifacts. All three arms are completed, authority blocker resolution is projected, Trace replay and rollback floors are marked verified, the plan has verification and application receipt digests, and the root active-loadout manifest equals the caller-supplied post-loadout manifest.
new_counterexample.expected: Reject runtime and deployed proof because an applied swap has no operation-bound readback proving that the target component generation became active and that the replaced generation ceased to be active.
new_counterexample.cause: experimentRow treats plan state, opaque verification and application receipt digests, and post_loadout_manifest_sha256 as the complete execution postcondition. The root constructor binds that manifest digest to active_loadout but never joins an applied swap to an active target component generation, an inactive replaced generation, or an operation-bound post-component snapshot or readback artifact. The public revalidator rebuilds through the same incomplete join.

preserved_prior_blockers.residual_cause: operation admission still lacks an exact post-component generation readback

largest_evidenced_gap: The repair proves that the caller-supplied post-loadout manifest matches the root active-loadout manifest, but it does not prove that an applied swap changed the active component generation. A complete valid chain can therefore report runtime_verified and deployed_verified while its target component remains inactive and the replaced component remains active.
required_repair: Project a complete immutable operation-result or post-operation readback artifact that binds operation, plan_id, plan_sha256, capsule and decision identities, before and after loadout manifests, target component identities and generations, observed lifecycle and active states, receipt class, and causal observation time.

For an applied swap, require the exact target generation to be active and the replaced same-logical-identity generation to be inactive or valid-time closed. For rollback, require the parent generation to be active and the candidate generation to be inactive. Keep replay explicitly non-activating.
Derive post_loadout_manifest_sha256 and component postconditions from the validated operation-result artifact instead of accepting independent caller-supplied digests.

Bind verification, application, replay, rollback, training-gate, and deployment receipt identities to their exact operation and artifact chain through validated receipt envelopes; keep issuer authenticity as a separate non-claim until independently verified.

Mirror every expressible postcondition in the public schema, freeze the runtime and deployed hashes above plus their public-revalidator variants as regressions, rebuild the exact manifest and source receipt, and request a distinct fresh critic.
